products_list.description:
Italian 925 Sterling Silver Paperclip Chain – 6mm | 22"

Crafted in Italy from genuine .925 sterling silver, this paperclip chain combines modern, geometric style with classic Italian craftsmanship. Featuring sleek, elongated oval links connected in a clean, airy pattern, it delivers a bold contemporary look that lies effortlessly flat against the chest.

At 6mm wide, the links make a distinct statement while keeping a comfortable, lightweight feel on the neck. The 22-inch length falls just below the collarbone—ideal for wearing solo, stacking with other chains, or clipping on pendants and charms directly to the open links.

Why You'll Love It
Genuine .925 sterling silver, stamped for guaranteed purity
Made in Italy by skilled silversmiths with smooth, precision-crafted links
Mirror-bright high polish that gives each elongated link a clean, luminous shine
6mm width, offering a bold, modern silhouette that sits flat without twisting
22-inch length, versatile for standalone wear or multi-chain layering
Secure lobster clasp, easy to fasten and built for daily wear
Hypoallergenic & nickel-free, gentle on sensitive skin

Italian 925 Sterling Silver Rope Chain – 6mm | 22"

At 6mm thick, it offers a substantial, noticeable presence without feeling overly bulky—strong enough to wear solo as a centerpiece or paired with a heavy pendant. The 22-inch length rests comfortably just below the collarbone, making it a versatile fit for everyday wear or dressing up.

products_list.description:
Italian 925 Sterling Silver Figaro Chain – 9mm | 22"
This Figaro chain is made in Italy from solid .925 sterling silver. The pattern is the classic Figaro: groups of short, flat links broken up by one longer link, repeated along the chain.

At 9mm wide, it's a heavy chain that stands out whether you wear it by itself or with a pendant. The 22-inch length sits just below the collarbone and works for both men and women.

Why You'll Love It
Genuine .925 sterling silver, stamped to show it's authentic
Made in Italy by skilled silversmiths, with tight, even links
Polished to a high shine that catches the light
9mm wide, with real weight and a solid feel
22-inch length that suits most necklines
Secure lobster clasp, easy to put on and take off
Hypoallergenic and safe for everyday wear
